title: Language-Guided Tokenization for Generation
one_line: Text-conditioned tokenization for faster image generation with quality trade-offs
innovations: First to condition tokenization on detailed text captions
Text tokens provide high-level semantic guidance, freeing token space for fine-grained details
Achieves 93.5× speedup with 32 tokens while outperforming original DiT
method_framework: TexTok uses frozen T5 text encoder to extract embeddings, injected into ViT tokenizer/detokenizer alongside image patches and learnable tokens, enabling semantic-guided compression.
experiment_framework: ImageNet 256/512 benchmarks, rFID/gFID/CLIP metrics, comparison with Baseline (w/o text) and SOTA methods like DiT, MAGVIT, MaskGIT.
takeaways: Text conditioning significantly improves reconstruction quality especially at low token counts
Method is orthogonal to existing techniques, can be combined with advanced generators
weaknesses: Relies on external text captions, may not generalize to caption-free scenarios
Computational overhead of text encoding not fully quantified
relevance_reason: 图像生成加速与可靠性主线无实质交点
